create_searchqa_dataset: create a SearchQA dataset instance that loads the search_qa HuggingFace dataset for text to text tasks
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of question category and answer tuples
load_searchqa_dataset: load the search_qa train_test_val dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training dev and test splits for the SearchQA dataset with a given seed
run_searchqa_preprocessing: run the SearchQA preprocessing pipeline to generate k-shot data across multiple random seeds
